title: Zesty Chicken & Chorizo Paella
description: A Spanish-style paella of chicken, chorizo and rice cooked in a smoked paprika, turmeric and cayenne stock, finished with lemon zest and peas.
steps: Heat oil in a large wok or pan. Add chorizo, chicken, onion, garlic, parsley stalks and grated carrot; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add red pepper, paprika, cayenne and turmeric; stir-fry 3 more minutes.
Crumble in stock cube; stir in rice until combined. Pour in boiling water; simmer 5 minutes.
Stir; simmer 10 more minutes, stirring regularly to prevent sticking.
Add peas; season; stir-fry 5 more minutes. Check rice is cooked.
Grate lemon zest over; scatter with parsley leaves; serve with lemon wedges.
notes: Add fried prawns stirred in once the paella is cooked.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
